record.oneLiner: Payments, billing, invoicing and account API for accepting and managing payments (REST).
record.verdictReason: Sandbox test keys are created self-serve in the Dashboard with no approval. The REST API covers payments, customers, subscriptions, invoices, refunds and more. Stripe ships an official hosted MCP server. Live-mode agent keys are subject to approval rules, which is a live-data governance feature and not a build blocker for sandbox use.

evidence.quote: The Stripe API authenticates requests using HTTP Basic Auth.
Create or select a sandbox and use its test keys.
Our API has predictable resource-oriented URLs, accepts form-encoded request bodies, returns JSON-encoded responses
The Stripe Model Context Protocol (MCP) server provides tools that AI agents can use to interact with the Stripe API
